name: Bento
tagline: Audits plugins, skills, MCP servers and rules across AI coding agents, keeping every context budget lean.
description: Bento brings every AI coding agent customization on your machine into one tidy tray. Instead of hunting across scattered dotfiles and hidden folders, you can inspect every installed plugin, skill, MCP server, and rule file side by side.

Both the native macOS app and the companion CLI (bentoctx) measure how much startup context each tool and instruction block consumes per agent, flagging duplicate schemas and idle MCP servers before they eat into your working token budget.

features.title: Cross-agent customization inventory
features.detail: Scans plugins, skills, MCP server definitions, and repository rule files across installed AI coding agents from a single read-only audit pass.

features.title: Per-agent context & token budget
features.detail: Estimates startup token weight for every rule, skill prompt, and MCP tool schema so you see immediately which integrations crowd an agent's context window.

features.title: Profile packing & conflict lint
features.detail: Spots duplicate instructions, broken MCP command paths, and overlapping global vs workspace rules, letting you pack lean per-project profiles.

features.title: macOS tray + bentoctx CLI parity
features.detail: Toggle customizations visually from the macOS app or script repeatable budget checks in shell workflows and pre-flight hooks with bentoctx.

install.label: Homebrew Cask
install.note: Installs the macOS app alongside the bentoctx CLI binary.
